import copy,json
from work import evaluate

def check(req, ev, pol, expected):
    before=copy.deepcopy((req,ev,pol))
    got=evaluate(req,ev,pol)
    assert got==expected,(got,expected)
    assert (req,ev,pol)==before

p={'required_conditions':['b','a'],'require_verified':True}
check({'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1}},[],p,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['b']})
base={'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':{'y':2,'x':1},'b':'B'}}
r1={'source':'S1','claim':'c','value':{'z':0,'a':[1,2]},'conditions':{'a':{'x':1,'y':2},'b':'B'},'verified':True}
r2={'source':'S2','claim':'c','value':{'a':[1,2],'z':0},'conditions':{'a':{'y':2,'x':1},'b':'B'},'verified':True}
check(base,[r1,r2],p,{'status':'supported','value':r1['value'],'sources':['S1','S2'],'unknowns':[]})
check(base,[r1,{**r2,'value':9}],p,{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['S1','S2'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
check(base,[r1,{**r2,'value':9},{**r2,'source':'S3','value':9}],p,{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['S1','S2','S3'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
check(base,[{**r1,'withdrawn':True},{**r2,'verified':False}],p,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
check(base,[{**r1,'value':False}],p,{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['S1'],'unknowns':[]})
check(base,[r1,{**r2,'supersedes':['S1']}],p,{'status':'supported','value':r2['value'],'sources':['S2'],'unknowns':[]})
check(base,[{**r1,'supersedes':['S1']}],p,{'status':'supported','value':r1['value'],'sources':['S1'],'unknowns':[]})
with open('requests.json') as f: requests=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json') as f: evidence=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report==[evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests]
print('all checks passed')
